title: My dreams are completely gone.
content: My biggest fear has came to see me . I should have never joined this mall world sub . My dreams are gone . It’s like I said something about mall world that I wasn’t supposed to say now in banned & it sucks because I knew when I slept I would go to one of my places but even if I do I don’t remember and it just sucks sorry for crying like a baby but damn it’s been like 3 weeks and I miss it dearly.
